summary: Iteration 24 — Validated Plume Astrale Premium subscription flow with 7-day trial, SocialProof endpoint, and full non-regression on auth/energy/credits/wallet. 9/9 backend tests passing.
critical_code_review_comments: premium_subscription.create_premium_checkout persists stripe_customer_id on first call. Side-effect: subsequent /premium/portal calls will succeed (200) even before any actual subscription is purchased, since a Customer exists. This is acceptable per Stripe (portal handles trialing/no-subs gracefully) but the docstring 'Aucun abonnement actif' is misleading — it actually checks customer existence, not subscription activity. Consider also checking premium_status before allowing portal access if business rules require it.
premium_subscription.py uses module-level _PRICE_ID_CACHE without thread/process safety; harmless under single-worker uvicorn but flag if scaling out.
server.py is 690 lines — close to the 700-line soft cap from review guidelines; consider extracting premium/credits routes into routers for maintainability.

social_proof endpoint silently returns 0 on Supabase exceptions (msgs/users/energies fallbacks). If Supabase auth fails the counter could legitimately be 0 → label hidden, hiding a real outage. Consider logging warnings + a health-check flag in the response.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md — plume_test_863a0303@gmail.com / TestPlume2026! and admin@plume-astrale.fr / AdminPlume2026!. Both authenticate via Supabase /auth/v1/token.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests only generate Stripe Checkout sessions (no actual payment). Stripe customer_id may be persisted on the test user profile by Stripe.Customer.create — this is expected by the implementation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe live key sk_live_... is working — all Stripe API calls (Price, Customer, Checkout, Billing Portal) return 200. NO AuthenticationError observed. Premium checkout creates a subscription session with mode=subscription, currency=eur, locale=fr, and amount_total=0 (proving the 7-day trial is applied — Stripe doesn't echo subscription_data.trial_period_days on session.retrieve, so amount_total=0 + €14.99 unit price is the indirect proof). The portal endpoint returns 200 once a Customer exists; this is correct Stripe behavior. SocialProof threshold logic (>=100 → visible) verified.
